title: Second Copy
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Second Copy and the helm marks Print Yard. Do: Close on Print Yard. An ambush skiff holds the bad copies until you enter 520 meters. The Print Factor reads which copy is yours if you come alongside. Finish: come inside Print Yard's shell. The Charter writes standing. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
